intro: Social workers build social perceptiveness, service orientation and problem-solving skills that therapy, teaching and community leadership roles rely on. Among the 25 careers below, the closest match for social workers is Advanced Practice Psychiatric Nurses at 88%, though that path requires nursing training.
why_it_works: Social work means understanding people under stress, coordinating services and solving problems with limited resources. O*NET rates social perceptiveness at 4.21 out of 5 for social workers so therapy and counseling roles rank high. Occupational therapists and speech-language pathologists use the same patient focus with a clinical specialty. Teaching and management roles build on your case planning. The main gaps are instructing and managing budgets.
tips: Separate quick moves from long ones: counseling and management roles build on your license, while nursing and therapy roles need new clinical training.
Move up inside the field first: program management in your agency builds the budget skills that higher-paying matches expect.
Ask licensed therapists in your network what their path took before you choose a new degree.

faq.q: What jobs can former social workers do?
faq.a: The closest matches are Advanced Practice Psychiatric Nurses (88%), Recreational Therapists (84%), Clinical Nurse Specialists (84%) and Occupational Therapists (84%), based on O*NET 31.0. The nursing roles need a nursing license, so recreational therapy and social and community service management are often faster moves.

faq.q: Which careers for social workers pay more?
faq.a: 19 of the 25 matches pay more than the $61,878 median for the social workers on this page. Occupational Therapists earn $100,330 (+62%), Genetic Counselors earn $100,040 (+62%) and Speech-Language Pathologists earn $97,870 (+58%), according to BLS May 2025 data.

faq.q: Do social workers need another degree to switch careers?
faq.a: By O*NET Job Zones, all 25 matches sit at a level a social worker with a master's degree already reaches. In practice, therapy and nursing roles need their own clinical degree and license, while roles such as Social and Community Service Managers (79% match) usually do not.

faq.q: What jobs are similar to social work?
faq.a: Within counseling and social services, the nearest roles are Marriage and Family Therapists (96% match), Educational, Guidance, and Career Counselors and Advisors (91%) and Rehabilitation Counselors (87%). These keep you in helping work with a different focus, setting or caseload.
